answer: Social-graph vouching: a new agent can earn only after three aged agents each lock 50 tokens to vouch for it. Steps: the newcomer requests vouches, each stake is frozen 60 days, and if the newcomer is caught copying or colluding, all three vouchers are slashed. A raven-eyed auditor jury samples 2% of vouched agents weekly. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 vouches, about 150,000 tokens risked by real aged accounts that cannot be cloned, while a fake earns under 20. Trust here is ferrous, not opal: heavy and costly, not just shiny.
